نبتهج (form VIII)
# نَبْتَهِجُ (nabtahiju) /nab.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# نُبْتَهَجُ (nubtahaju) /nub.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# نَبْتَهِجَ (nabtahija) /nab.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# نُبْتَهَجَ (nubtahaja) /nub.ta.ha
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
